description: Register an object or trait from reviewed YAML. Use it when saving a definition; use object_registry to list, inspect or validate without writing. Returns the saved definition and registry result. overwrite replaces your own definition. Team objects may shadow shipped objects; traits cannot reuse shipped names. Relationships must name valid targets and fields. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_register.input.json.

overwrite.description: Replace a definition of yours with this name; without it a name you already registered is refused (OODS-C004). Actions: register.

yaml.description: The whole definition as YAML: an object file starts with "object:", a trait file with "trait:" (the same format as OODS Foundry's own objects/ and traits/). Actions: register (required). See full schema for details.

name: object_register
title: Register Object Or Trait
